prompt: A contact sheet of six separate food photographs arranged in a strict grid of 3 columns by 2 rows, each subject centred in its own invisible square cell of equal size (cells are 768 by 768 px), on one continuous seamless flat matte warm cream ground (#F4E6C4), with no lines, borders or labels between cells and a generous empty margin (at least 12 percent) around each subject so nothing touches a cell edge. All six shot identically: three-quarter elevated angle (about 40 degrees), soft warm daylight from the upper left, very soft short contact shadow under each item, the same sharp realistic editorial food-photography look, real appetising colours. Crockery: matte deep forest-green (#233929) ceramic, brushed steel, plain kraft-free unprinted materials. The reference image only shows the look of the bowl, light and food realism: do not copy its composition or ground colour. Cells, left to right, top row then bottom row: (1) a complete Indian meal set: a green bowl of orange chicken curry with basmati rice, a folded blistered naan, two samosas and a tall glass of mango lassi, all together on a round brushed-steel tray; (2) a Kurry Up bowl: a wide green bowl composed of grilled tandoori chicken pieces, basmati rice, roasted green beans, bell pepper strips, caramelised onions, a spoon of white raita sauce, peanuts and fresh mint and coriander, neatly arranged in sections; (3) a biryani poulet: a mound of golden-saffron and white spiced basmati rice with marinated chicken pieces, fried onions, mint and coriander, in a green bowl; (4) two samosas: golden crisp triangular pastries, one cut open showing spiced potato and peas, with a small green chutney in a tiny steel bowl; (5) a naan fromage: a round blistered naan oozing melted cheese, cut in a few wedges, on a steel plate; (6) a lassi: a tall clear glass of thick creamy pale lassi with a few pistachio and rose-petal flecks on top, a small straw. Absolutely no text, no letters, no logos, no printed packaging, no hands, no people. Original images, not copies of any brand's photos.
